Maria (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock down Q3 roadmap prioritization. FinCorp private deployment is pushing for Private + dedicated routing telemetry. Want alignment on framework + how we slice capacity. Thoughts?

Jon (Eng): @Maria what are must-haves vs nice-to-haves? Eng capacity looks tight with runtime kernel work landing Q3.

Sasha (Platform): Platform note: kernel optimizations + autoscale work is a 3-4 sprint effort (roughly 2 engs full-time) if we aim for p99 targets. That will block some Dedicated work.

Kevin (Data): From impact side: FinCorp ARR risk if delayed ~ $250k/quarter. Quick telemetry win (hosted routing visibility) is ~1 sprint, medium-high impact.

Rachel (Design): I can deliver onboarding mockups + consent screens in 2 sprints with 1 designer.

Priya (Support): Support queue trending: 6 open tickets requesting auth/KMS + on-prem docs. Burn rate is up.

Jon (Eng): Proposed scoring: use RICE but adjust 'effort' to engineering-weeks and include a cross-team blocker flag. Formula: `RICE = (reach * impact * confidence) / effort`.

Jon (Eng): ```
RICE example
reach=2000 users/month
impact=2 (0-3)
confidence=0.6
effort=8 wks
score=(2000*2*0.6)/8 = 300
```

Maria (PM): Suggest two swimlanes: Customer fast-path (time-limited, commit-based) and Platform runway. Initial cap allocation: 60% customer fast-path, 30% platform runway, 10% ops/triage for Q3 ramp. Open to pushback.

Sasha (Platform): Can we define fast-path acceptance criteria? e.g., must be deployable in <3 sprints, no kernel changes, and use hosted routing only.

Jon (Eng): +1. Also add gating: anything touching private infra needs security sign-off and a 1-day onboarding doc before rollout.

Kevin (Data): For FinCorp specifically, enterprise value skews RICE. Example using a multiplier: if ARR risk > threshold, apply customer-value multiplier to favor enterprise lanes.

Rachel (Design): Design effort is small; if engineering chunks an M1 hosted-only deliverable we can demo in ~3 weeks.

Priya (Support): Ops ask: if we take FinCorp fast-path we need a dedicated success manager + an SLA template. Heads-up that will pull 0.5 FTE from support.

Jon (Eng): My recommendation: greenlight routing telemetry + hosted onboarding as M1 (1 sprint) and defer full private infra until kernel/autoscale runway completes. If FinCorp signs reserved capacity or pays onboarding fee, escalate private lane.

Maria (PM): Decision: provisional ✅ — M1 = hosted routing telemetry + customer onboarding flow. Table full private Dedicated work pending either (a) a signed reserved capacity contract, or (b) an internal reprioritization after kernel work estimate.

Jon (Eng): Condition: if contract includes >6mo reserved capacity or ARR > $X we re-prioritize. Otherwise proceed with hosted-only fast-path.

Sasha (Platform): I'll provide exact reserved-cost numbers and capacity delta by EOD.

triage-bot: New task created: PLAT-342 "FinCorp hosted fast-path" assigned to @jon due 1951310000

Maria (PM): Action items: Jon — engineering proto + effort estimate; Sasha — cost calc; Rachel — mockups; Priya — SLA draft. Reconvene Monday 09:30 to lock roll plan. :thumbsup:
